invariants: Objective tracking identity is stable/non-reusable and separate from derived monthly ordinal
current persisted nonsuperseded Objective has at least one current Task membership
membership pins an exact accepted Task-plan revision and current Task plan may later differ until reviewed regroup acceptance
strict overlap uses half-open-style predicate start < other_end AND end > other_start so exact touching boundaries may remain separate
Objective aggregate state is rebuildable from member Task execution/outcome/inclusion and never becomes independent execution authority
regroup proposals and historical Objective proposals are non-authoritative until explicitly accepted
provider Complete plus accepted source plan may support reviewed historical structure but never fabricates execution/outcome/Inventory evidence
implementation_rule: All declared leaves are one normative Objective/grouping schema family and retain the original FK/index/nonempty/overlap obligations.
